demo.cliff: none — this is the plain case
teaches: The four fields every physical Item has: `weight`, `cost`, `tl` and `legality`.
`weightless` is the flag that keeps a worn or implanted thing out of the encumbrance total.
`subType: "clothing"` files it under clothing in the explorer's sub-type filter.
demo.trap: `tl` on an Item is the string `TL09`, not the number 9. It is one of the two fields the compendium explorer indexes, and a `9` written here is stored as the string `"9"` and filters as its own value.

system.description: Oiled canvas, four pockets and a harbour patch. Warm, and it dries.
